privacyPage.title: Privacy notice
privacyPage.version: Version {v}. A draft for review; not yet in force.
privacyPage.intro: This notice explains what Care Setu does with the details you give us when you leave your details on this website, so that you can decide whether to agree.

sections.title: What we collect
items: Where the patient is now: in hospital, at home, or not sure.
The service you ask about, or that you are not sure yet.
The area: Noida, Delhi or somewhere else.
What the patient needs, in your own words.
Your email address, if you give it.
The date and time you agreed to this notice, and which version of it you agreed to.
sections.text: Our server also holds your device’s internet address in memory for about 10 minutes, only to stop the form being sent over and over by automated programs. It is not stored. This page runs no advertising or tracking scripts.

sections.title: Why we collect it
sections.text: To call you back and arrange the care you asked about, including a care plan and a quote before you pay. We do not use these details for anything else, and never for marketing unless you separately agree.

sections.title: Who sees it
sections.text: The Care Setu team who arrange care. We have not yet chosen the email service that alerts the team or the provider that will host the data; this notice will name them before it takes effect.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.text: The period is not set yet. It will be stated here before this notice takes effect, and we will erase your details once they are no longer needed for the purpose above.

sections.title: Your rights
items: Withdraw your consent at any time, as easily as you gave it.
Ask for a summary of the details we hold about you and how we use them.
Ask us to correct, complete, update or erase them.
Raise a grievance with us, and get a response.
Nominate someone to exercise these rights if you die or cannot act yourself.
Complain to the Data Protection Board of India, after first using our grievance process.
sections.text: To do any of these, call, WhatsApp or email us using the details below, and mention your reference if you have one.

sections.title: Who to contact
sections.text: The person who answers questions about your details and handles grievances has not been named yet. Until then, contact us using these details.

review: The legal entity and name that appear as the data fiduciary (the LLP is not yet registered).
The retention period, and the named grievance officer with a response period.
The email and hosting providers, which process the details on our behalf.
Whether the free-text description of the patient’s needs, which can include health information, needs extra safeguards or a separate consent.
Commencement: the DPDP Rules, 2025 were published on 14 November 2025, and the notice and rights rules take effect eighteen months later. This draft is written to that standard now.
A Hindi version, so that the notice can be read in a language of the Eighth Schedule (Act, section 5(3)).
privacyPage.sources: Written against the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (sections 5, 6, 11 to 14) and the Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025 (rules 3, 9 and 14), as published by MeitY.
